answer: Make newcomers audit before they earn: each new identity must first grade a dozen jobs against hidden gold-standard rubrics, and only close matches gain the right to submit paid work. Starting at the nadir of trust, no identity skips this apprenticeship, and a violet marker on its record shows audits passed or failed. Standards rotate each epoch and jobs span domains, from labelling tundra satellite imagery to checking invoices, so a Sybil farmer cannot reuse one script: each fake account must pass its own audit set at time cost, while correlated grading exposes farms and burns deposits.
